zoe_pm: Opening thread to finalize the candidate curation + onboarding checklist for the design-partner pilot. Need something recruiters and SEs can copy into outreach and intake. Keep it short.

carlos_se: High-level ask: we want partners who exercise our routing/fallbacks and have real-time constraints. Prefer apps using chat, conversational search, or low-latency rerank.

tina_cs: Incentives: 10 weeks free Dedicated-lite OR $6k platform credit + 8 hours SE time. Add optional co-marketing if partner ok. Also offer a mentor pairing with a solutions engineer for the first month.

harry_research: Feedback plan idea: two-tier signals — operational (latency, error rates, token cost) and qualitative (feature asks, failure modes). Require partners to provide a 25-50 prompt seed set for evals. Partners who share anonymized prompts get priority for experiments.

viv_ops: Onboarding fast-path checklist (for low-friction partners): 1) provide sample traffic distribution (tokens/request, qps peaks) 2) whitelist IPs or provide service account 3) run our 400-request harness 4) accept telemetry sharing and trace header. Fast-path = sandbox + creds in 48h.

zoe_pm: Screening rubric suggestion: ProductFit (0-5), UsageSignal (0-5), ComplianceComplexity (0-5 inverted), ExperimentGoodwill (+1 if share prompts), StrategicValue (+1 for referral potential). Require avg >= 3.4 or manual PM review.

carlos_se: Technical intake template (short):
- Primary feature & SLA (e.g., chat p95 < 120ms)
- Typical payload size and tokens per request
- Peak concurrency and expected daily requests
- Residency / compliance constraints
- Can you run a replay harness? yes/no
- Will you share anonymized prompts for evals? yes/no

tina_cs: Add a legal checkbox: data purge agreement (confirm retention window <= 30 days for partner sandbox), and logging consent for anonymized traces. If they require longer retention or PII access, route to privacy review -> likely slow path.

harry_research: Acceptance criteria to graduate pilot: 1) successful harness pass (>=95% success on replay) 2) traces present and KV cache exercised 3) partner prompt eval drift <= 6% vs baseline 4) integration time <= 12 business days 5) no unresolved critical security items.

viv_ops: Operational guardrails: enable canary routing for early traffic, automatic rollback if p95 increases > 1.5x baseline, and an on-call rota for the first 72h after onboarding. We'll include a short runbook snippet partners can link to.

zoe_pm: Graduation -> public beta criteria: at least 6 partners across 2 waves pass acceptance, aggregate quality drift < 5%, median integration time <= 10 days, and at least 2 partners opt into case studies or testimonials. Also target at least 2 partners converting to paid Dedicated within 60 days.

carlos_se: Scope boundary: no architecture or dataset training changes in pilot. Small inference-side config changes allowed (quantization, scheduling) as long as partner confirms output parity. Any >8 engineer-hours of custom work is billable and requires sign-off.

tina_cs: Recruiter outreach script (one-liner): "Hi — we're running a small pilot for Redwood Inference to optimize latency+cost for real-time LLM use-cases; we offer credits, SE support, and co-marketing. Would you be open to a 20-min screening call?"

harry_research: Exit survey (6 fields): NPS, top 2 blockers, top 3 feature asks (ranked), perceived perf vs baseline, integration friction (1-5), willingness to convert or be a reference. Keep it < 8 Qs.

viv_ops: Fast-path note: mark partners needing VPC/on-prem early — route to Private team and expect >3 week lead. Also toggle for KMS/HSM requirements.

infra-bot: infra: dp-onboarding-playbook v0.9 published to /internal/playbooks/dp-onboard (audit id: dp-9099).
